create_queue_instance: create a Queue instance with a custom max_size_bytes for multiprocessing communication
put_message: put a message into the Queue with optional blocking and timeout parameters
get_many_messages: get many messages from the Queue at once with configurable max_messages_to_get limit
get_single_message: get a single message from the Queue with optional blocking and timeout parameters
close_queue: close the Queue and clean up underlying multiprocessing resources
